latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the ER11 reviser assignment and marked the native Goal complete.

- [Complete final](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/treatment/reviser/final.md>)
- [Source map](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/treatment/reviser/source-map.json>)
- [Evidence index](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/treatment/reviser/sources/index.md>) and [verification notes](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/A-M11-B/treatment/reviser/sources/01-reviser-verifications.md>)

The final covers P1–P6 and O1–O6, preserves alternatives and uncertainties, and separates proposed validations from work performed. It incorporates the Notice-type conditions in the [Local Contexts FAQ](https://localcontexts.org/support/frequently-asked-questions/) and the version- and pagination-specific history in [Meilisearch issue #5274](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5274). PostgreSQL and Solr are included as conditional alternatives, not selections ([PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/textsearch-intro.html), [Solr](https://solr.apache.org/guide/solr/latest/getting-started/searching-in-solr.html)).

The source map parsed successfully and the stated clause/obligation coverage was checked. No implementation tests or benchmarks were run. Goal usage: 157,054 tokens over 5m 19s.
